```{r}
#| echo: false
#| eval: false
yrate <- 1.02^12
amounts <- 1000 * yrate^(0:10)
tibble::tibble(
  Year = 0:10,
  Amount = amounts,
  ProportionChange = Amount / lag(Amount),
  Magnitude = log10(Amount)
) |>
  mutate(Amount = round(Amount),
  Year = Year + 2027) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| eval: false
library(lubridate)
Covid <- readr::read_csv("~/Downloads/case-hosp-death.csv")

Covid <- Covid |> 
dplyr::mutate(
    date = mdy(DATE_OF_INTEREST),
    doy = yday(date))

ggplot(Covid |> head(12), aes(x = date, y = CASE_COUNT)) +
  geom_point() 
```
